name: vLLM on 4x MI250: Llama-2-70b-hf FP16 b1 128in/128out throughput
methodology: Argonne LLM-Inference-Bench (arXiv:2411.00136), 4x MI250 on Polaris cluster. vLLM 0.6.1 FP16, batch 1, 128in/128out. Throughput = batch*(input+output)/end-to-end latency (Eq.2). per-request batch-1. Reported 'Throughput(tok/s)' column.
notes: MI250 (128GB HBM2e, 3.28 TB/s) on Argonne Polaris. First measured record on amd-instinct-mi250.
